theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), 1 ≤ n → ν univ ≠ 0 → ν univ ≠ ∞ → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ w : Euclid P, f (t • w) = f w) → ν ≠ (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)).withDensity f
